<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes for #9788  

## Changes proposed

- Updated get_local_users.py to remove the user count check

## Context for reviewers

The `get_local_users` service in get_local_users.py has a check that
raises an exception if more than 500 users exist in the database. This
was intended as a safety net to prevent accidental execution in
production, but it's redundant as `error_if_not_local()` already guards
against non-local environments.

The check is now causing `test_get_local_users_200` to fail in the full
test suite because the session-scoped DB schema accumulates users across
all tests, and recent feature work has pushed the count past 500.

## Validation steps

Confirm `make test` passes with the full suite

works fine in builds/deployed as well.

upgrade it otherwise.

head_commit.message:
[Issue #7302] Wire up attachment upload widget to opportunity edit form (#9730)

## Summary

Work for #7302

## Changes proposed

- **`OpportunityAttachmentUploadWidget`** — Fully implemented: i18n via
`useTranslations`, 2GB client-side file size validation, error `Alert`
on upload/delete failure, `isDraft` prop (disables input and hides
Remove buttons for non-draft opportunities), `deletable` flag
(initially-loaded attachments are display-only since the grantor GET
response does not return `opportunity_attachment_id`),
`crypto.randomUUID()` for stable unique keys on display-only files
- **`OpportunityEditForm`** — Added Attachments section wired to the
widget; section layout matches Figma (`display-flex flex-column gap-3`,
`padding-bottom-4`); accepts `initialAttachments` prop
- **`opportunityResponseTypes`** — `GrantorOpportunityDetail` now uses
`Omit<OpportunityDetail, "attachments">` to avoid type conflict between
`OpportunityDocument[]` (public endpoint) and `OpportunityAttachment[]`
(grantor endpoint)
- **`page.tsx`** — Passes `initialAttachments` to `OpportunityEditForm`;
passes `attachments: []` to `buildOpportunityEditInitialValues` (which
does not use attachments) to satisfy the `OpportunityDetail` type
- **`i18n/messages/en/index.ts`** — Added `content.attachmentsIntro` and
`attachments.*` error/action strings

## Context for reviewers

**Why `deletable: false` for initially-loaded attachments?** The grantor
GET endpoint (`/grantors/opportunities/{id}`) returns attachments via
`OpportunityAttachmentV1Schema` which does not serialize
`opportunity_attachment_id`. Without an ID we cannot call the delete
endpoint, so these files are shown as read-only. Only freshly uploaded
files (which get an ID back from the upload response) can be deleted.

**Why `Omit<OpportunityDetail, "attachments">`?** The public opportunity
detail uses `OpportunityDocument[]` (with `download_path`,
`file_description`) while the grantor endpoint uses
`OpportunityAttachment[]` (with `opportunity_attachment_id`,
`mime_type`, `file_size`). These are incompatible types so we omit and
re-declare rather than extend directly.

**Why `crypto.randomUUID()` for display-only files?** Initially-loaded
files have no `opportunity_attachment_id`, so we generate a stable UUID
at init time to ensure unique React list keys even when multiple files
share the same filename.

## Validation steps

1. Load the edit page for a draft opportunity with existing attachments
— files appear in the list (no Remove button)
2. Upload a new file — it appears in the list with a Remove button
3. Upload the same filename twice — no duplicate key console errors
4. Upload a file >2GB — error alert appears, file not added to list
5. Click Remove → confirm in modal → file removed from list
6. Click Remove → cancel → file remains
7. Load the edit page for a non-draft opportunity — file input is
disabled, no Remove buttons

(initially-loaded attachments are display-only since the grantor GET
response does not return `opportunity_attachment_id`),
`crypto.randomUUID()` for stable unique keys on display-only files
- **`OpportunityEditForm`** — Added Attachments section wired to the
widget; section layout matches Figma (`display-flex flex-column gap-3`,
`padding-bottom-4`); accepts `initialAttachments` prop
- **`opportunityResponseTypes`** — `GrantorOpportunityDetail` now uses
`Omit<OpportunityDetail, "attachments">` to avoid type conflict between
`OpportunityDocument[]` (public endpoint) and `OpportunityAttachment[]`
(grantor endpoint)

passes `attachments: []` to `buildOpportunityEditInitialValues` (which
does not use attachments) to satisfy the `OpportunityDetail` type

`attachments.*` error/action strings

GET endpoint (`/grantors/opportunities/{id}`) returns attachments via
`OpportunityAttachmentV1Schema` which does not serialize

files (which get an ID back from the upload response) can be deleted.

`mime_type`, `file_size`). These are incompatible types so we omit and
re-declare rather than extend directly.

files have no `opportunity_attachment_id`, so we generate a stable UUID
at init time to ensure unique React list keys even when multiple files
share the same filename.

— files appear in the list (no Remove button)

6. Click Remove → cancel → file remains

disabled, no Remove buttons
